description: Replication Data for: Anomalous far field ground subsidence induced by the 2023 Mw 6.8 Morocco earthquake is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Harvard Dataverse. This dataset is used to supplement the original interferograms of the paper titled "Anomalous far field ground subsidence induced by the 2023 Mw 6.8 Morocco earthquake" by Bo Lv, Chen Yu, and Xiaoning Hu et al. Coverage: Morocco. The portal files it under the publisher Harvard Dataverse. Its tags are Earth and Environmental Sciences, 023 Morocco earthquake; Far field earthquake effect; Oulad Berhil ground subsidence; InSAR deformation time series. The repository dates the deposit 2025; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
